question.text: A dynamic bond fund differs from other debt funds primarily because it:

answer.text: Has no restrictions on maturity profile and moves across the yield curve based on opportunities
Has a fixed portfolio that never changes

explanation.text: The Logic: Dynamic bond funds have no restrictions on the types of securities they hold or on their maturity profile, allowing the fund manager to move across the yield curve. Duration is actively managed based on the manager's view on interest rates. The Trap: Gilt funds, not dynamic bond funds, are the ones restricted to government securities. Dynamic bond funds can invest across debt instruments. Note: Duration is shifted dynamically in response to rate-view changes, which is the defining feature of this category.
